name: Tsuma wa Kon'ya mo Ubawareru ~Seiso Kei Kyonyuu Hitozuma wa Choukyouzumi Niku Ana Dorei~
original_name: 妻は今夜も奪われる～清楚系巨乳人妻は調教済み肉穴奴隷～
source:
You (the protagonist) work at a major publishing company. Your wife, Sakura, is a beautiful, busty, and elegant woman two years older than you. While you and your beloved wife, Sakura, are enjoying a happy life together, one day, you receive an order from your boss to entertain the renowned writer, Haramura Seizo, along with a senior editor, to request a new book from him.
...
Little did you know that in the process, a deep, dark shadow would be cast over your beloved wife’s past and present.
She is innocent, gentle, calm, and has the most beautiful face and body that anyone could ever envy.
You will witness her unknown face and hear her unknown voice. ……
Unlike the sex that confirms your love for each other, she will indulge in an animalistic copulation...
She shakes her big tits and buttocks and screams out in a vulgar climax: ……
Is your beloved wife a slutty bitch masquerading as a neat and tidy wife? ……
Or is she a loving wife masquerading as a slut to protect her happiness with you? ……
You are about to find out: ……
translation:
你（主角）在一家大出版社工作。你的妻子櫻良比你大兩歲，容貌美麗、胸部豐滿、舉止優雅。你正與心愛的妻子櫻良過著幸福生活，有一天，上司命你和一位資深編輯一起招待著名作家原村精藏，請他寫一本新書。
……
你怎麼也沒想到，這件事會給愛妻的過去和現在投下一片深沉的陰影。
她純真、溫柔、沉靜，有著任誰都會羨慕的絕美容顏與身材。
你將親眼見到她不為你所知的一面，親耳聽見她從未讓你聽過的聲音。……
她將沉溺於野獸般的交媾，和你們確認彼此愛意的性愛截然不同……
她抖動著碩大的乳房與臀部，在高潮中發出淫蕩的尖叫……
你心愛的妻子，難道是個假扮清純賢妻的淫蕩婊子？……
還是說，她是為了守護與你的幸福而假扮蕩婦的賢妻？……
你馬上就會知道……
